svg.title: Prahari — workflow and integration
svg.desc: Two paths: a vehicle passing a camera through to an acknowledged alert, and a registration number through to an audited route export.
svg.text: Two paths. Both end on the same hash-chained audit log.
measured 0.68 s frame to sighting, against a 3.0 s budget

Administering a surveillance system and using one are different jobs.
